Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Qur’an 1.1 Ulumul Qur’an (8 lessons) By the end of the sub-strand, the learner s
Topic 1.2: Selected Chapters 90:1

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Selected Chapters 90:1. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What lessons do Muslims learn from the selected surah?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read surah Ad-Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) and surah Al-Balad (Q. 90:1-20) correctly for spiritual nourishment
2. explain the meaning of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) for better understanding
3. apply the teachings of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93: 1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) in their daily life to earn rewards from Allah
4. appreciate the teachings of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93: 1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) as a guide in daily life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: SELECTED CHAPTERS 90:1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 7
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Selected Chapters 90:1 helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: SELECTED CHAPTERS 90:1
Study Selected Chapters 90:1 like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Read surah Ad-Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) and surah Al-Balad (Q. 90:1-20) correctly for spiritual nourishment

What this means
In this part you learn to read surah Ad-Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) and surah Al-Balad (Q. 90:1-20) correctly for spiritual nourishment. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: read surah Ad-Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) and surah Al-Balad (Q. 90:1-20) correctly for spiritual nourishment.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Selected Chapters 90:1” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can read surah Ad-Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) and surah Al-Balad (Q. 90:1-20) correctly for spiritual nourishment. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Explain the meaning of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) for better understanding

What this means
In this part you learn to explain the meaning of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) for better understanding. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain the meaning of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) for better understanding.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Selected Chapters 90:1 in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain the meaning of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) for better understanding. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Apply the teachings of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93: 1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) in their daily life to earn rewards from Allah

What this means
In this part you learn to apply the teachings of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93: 1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) in their daily life to earn rewards from Allah. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply the teachings of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93: 1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) in their daily life to earn rewards from Allah.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply the teachings of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93: 1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) in their daily life to earn rewards from Allah. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Appreciate the teachings of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93: 1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) as a guide in daily life

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the teachings of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93: 1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) as a guide in daily life. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the teachings of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93: 1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) as a guide in daily life.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Selected Chapters 90:1” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the teachings of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93: 1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) as a guide in daily life. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Selected Chapters 90:1 is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Selected Chapters 90:1” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: read surah Ad-Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) and surah Al-Balad (Q. 90:1-20) correctly for spiritual nourishment)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Selected Chapters 90:1 in your own words. (skill: explain the meaning of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) for better understanding)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: apply the teachings of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93: 1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) in their daily life to earn rewards from Allah)

Example 4: Show how “Selected Chapters 90:1” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: appreciate the teachings of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93: 1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) as a guide in daily life)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Selected Chapters 90:1 to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: read surah Ad-Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) and surah Al-Balad (Q. 90:1-20) correctly for spiritual nourishment.
3. Practise this skill: explain the meaning of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) for better understanding.
4. Practise this skill: apply the teachings of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93: 1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) in their daily life to earn rewards from Allah.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Selected Chapters 90:1 from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Selected Chapters 90:1: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Selected Chapters 90:1?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What lessons do Muslims learn from the selected surah?
2. How can a Muslim apply the teachings of the selected surah?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Selected Chapters 90:1 means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: read surah Ad-Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) and surah Al-Balad (Q. 90:1-20) correctly for spiritual nourishment.
5. Be able to: explain the meaning of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) for better understanding.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
